narrative: The model estimated a 52% chance you would fail the bar exam on your first attempt, so the admission decision reflects a slightly-more-likely-than-not concern rather than a certainty. The strongest factor was your Law School Admission Test score: 21, well below the 37.18 average among accepted students, and it pushed the prediction toward bar failure more than any other item.
